seo.title: Thyme: Southrop Village Honeymoon Review 2026
seo.description: A village reimagined as a hotel — cottages, spa, Ox Barn restaurant. Score 88/100, from $700/night. Best cottage, 7-night plan.

content.verdict: Thyme is the most distinctive small hotel in the Cotswolds — Caryn Hibbert's decades-long project to restore an entire Cotswold village (Southrop, near Lechlade) into a working country estate with 31 rooms and suites spread across the manor house, the tithe barn, and a dozen restored Cotswold-stone cottages along the village lane. The kitchen garden is two acres of biodynamic vegetables that supply the Ox Barn restaurant — the centrepiece of the property, a 17th-century stone barn with a vast oak-trussed roof and one of the best country restaurants in England under head chef Charlie Hibbert (Caryn's son). The Bothy Spa is small but exceptional — six treatment rooms, a 15m indoor pool with skylight, a hammam, and Bamford Botanic products developed on the estate. There's a cookery school in a converted Victorian school house, a still room making botanical apothecary products, a tweed-themed Baa Bar in the original village pub, and walks along the River Leach. The honeymoon proposition is the village-as-hotel concept: you walk to dinner along a real Cotswold lane, you breakfast in the Tithe Barn with the kitchen garden visible through the windows, your cottage is a genuine 17th-century house with a real fireplace and a private garden. Thyme feels less like a hotel and more like staying as a guest of an extraordinary host who happens to own a village. The differentiator versus Foxhill Manor is informality and design — Thyme is more contemporary, more design-led, more focused on food and wellness; Foxhill is more traditional country-house, more sociable, more no-menu. The caveats are real: the property is spread across a village, which means walking between buildings — lovely in summer, less so in November rain. The Ox Barn restaurant is open to non-guests, which can mean a busy main room some evenings. And Southrop itself is small — you'll need a car for villages further afield. For honeymoon couples who want a design-driven, food-focused, contemporary country-house experience, Thyme is the strongest pick in the Cotswolds. The honeymoon move is five nights in an Ox-House Suite or one of the cottage suites, a cookery class together, a spa morning, dinner at the Ox Barn most nights, and the kitchen-garden tour.
content.best_room: The Ox-House Suite — the trophy room in the converted Ox House with a vaulted bedroom, private garden, and a freestanding copper bath in the room. The Bothy Suites in the converted cottages on the village lane are the most romantic — each its own house with garden and fireplace. Alternatively, a Tithe Barn Suite for proximity to the restaurant and spa. Avoid the small Tallet rooms above the spa — fine but lose the Thyme village magic.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Arrival and Ox Barn dinner
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 100 min from London Heathrow or train Paddington to Kemble (75 min) then 30 min taxi. Check-in to your Ox-House Suite, welcome drinks. Dinner at the Ox Barn — kitchen-garden tasting menu, biodynamic wines.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Cookery class together
itinerary_7_nights.description: Half-day cookery class at the Thyme cookery school (book at reservation). Lunch from what you cooked. Afternoon nap, evening drink at the Baa Bar, casual dinner in the Tithe Barn.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Bibury and Burford day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 20 min to Bibury for the Arlington Row cottages, then 20 min to Burford for the High Street antique shops. Lunch at The Lamb in Burford. Return via Daylesford Organic to shop. Spa hammam evening.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Kitchen-garden tour and spa
itinerary_7_nights.description: Morning tour of the two-acre kitchen garden with the head gardener. Long lunch at the Ox Barn. Long afternoon at the Bothy Spa — couples' treatment, swim, hammam. Cocktails in the still room.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Cotswold Way half-day walk
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 30 min to Painswick for the Rococo Garden and the Cotswold Way ridge walk to Slad (the Laurie Lee village). Lunch at The Woolpack. Return for fireside drinks and dinner.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Cirencester and Highgrove
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 20 min to Cirencester — the Roman museum and Saturday market. Pre-book a Highgrove Garden tour (King Charles's estate) if available. Lunch at Made by Bob. Final dinner at the Ox Barn.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Slow departure
itinerary_7_nights.description: Last breakfast in the Tithe Barn, final kitchen-garden walk, drive to London or train from Kemble.

caveats: Thyme is spread across a village — you walk between your cottage, the restaurant, and the spa. Lovely in summer; bring boots and a waxed jacket for autumn-winter.
The Ox Barn restaurant is open to non-staying guests — Saturday evenings particularly can feel busy in the main room. Book early dinner sittings for the calm window.
The location is south Cotswolds — closer to Cirencester and Bath than to Stow or Broadway. Plan day trips accordingly; the iconic northern villages are 45 min away.

faqs.question: Good for honeymooners?
faqs.answer: Thyme is one of the best honeymoon hotels in the Cotswolds — particularly for design-loving, food-loving couples who want a contemporary country-house experience. The cottage suites along the village lane deliver real privacy and romance.

faqs.question: Best time to visit?
faqs.answer: May, June, and September are ideal — the kitchen garden at its peak, full Cotswold walks open, dry weather. December for the Christmas programme with the Tithe Barn dressed for festive dinners.

faqs.question: Book in advance?
faqs.answer: Ox-House Suite and Bothy Suites for May-September: 6-9 months ahead. Cookery school dates: 3-4 months. Bothy Spa couples' treatment: 2-3 months.

faqs.question: Adults-only?
faqs.answer: No formally, but the food-and-wellness focus and the village layout mean the guest mix skews adult. School-holiday weeks bring some families.

faqs.question: Best room type?
faqs.answer: Ox-House Suite for the trophy room with private garden. Bothy Suites in the village cottages for the most romantic stay. Tithe Barn Suites for proximity to dining and spa. Avoid the small Tallet rooms.

faqs.question: How to get there?
faqs.answer: London Heathrow 100 min drive, London Paddington train to Kemble 75 min then 30 min taxi, or to Swindon 60 min then 35 min taxi. The property arranges transfers from either station.
